clean_source_blocks.text: Right-wing candidate Keiko Fujimori has been declared the winner of Peru's tight presidential election, nearly a month after the vote took place. The 51-year-old won 50.135% of voters' support in the runoff, held on 7 June, to 49.865% for left-wing candidate Roberto Sánchez - a margin of less than 50,000 votes, figures certified by Peru's electoral court show. It is the fourth time the daughter of disgraced former President Alberto Fujimori has sought the South American nation's presidency, promising this time to oversee a crackdown on organised crime. Her election, coinciding with the election of Abelardo de la Espriella in Colombia, marks a shift towards the right in Latin American politics. Fujimori said she would assume the role of president "with responsibility, humility and a deep sense of duty".
The daughter of disgraced president Alberto Fujimori is declared winner of tight race nearly a month after voting took place.

In a razor-thin race marred by protests and accusations, Keiko Fujimori has been declared the winner of Peru's presidential election by the electoral office. She secured 50.135% of the vote, narrowly defeating her rival, Roberto Sanchez, amidst allegations of fraud and a highly contested ballot review. Fujimori announced her commitment to new governance priorities aimed at healing a fractured nation. Her win is a reversal from her narrow 2021 loss and showcases Peru's continued deep political polarization. Meanwhile, Roberto Sanchez, backed by rural supporters, has not acknowledged her victory, citing unproven electoral fraud.

Throughout the campaign, she leant on the controversial legacy of her father, promising a military crackdown on organised crime, in particular extortion incidents that have soared in recent years. Alberto Fujimori was eventually jailed for crimes against humanity over extra-judicial killings and forced sterilisations undertaken during his increasingly authoritarian leadership. Keiko also pledged to attract private investment to promote economic growth and to immediately expel any undocumented immigrants found to be committing crimes in Peru. She stood unsuccessfully in 2011, 2016 and 2021, losing by similarly tight margins, during a period of intense political instability in Peru. She will become the Andean country's ninth president in a decade. Her swearing-in ceremony is expected to take place on 28 July. original_article.description: The daughter of disgraced president Alberto Fujimori is declared winner of tight race nearly a month after voting took place.
original_article.research:
[Lähde: BBC World]
Right-wing candidate Keiko Fujimori has been declared the winner of Peru's tight presidential election, nearly a month after the vote took place.

The 51-year-old won 50.135% of voters' support in the runoff, held on 7 June, to 49.865% for left-wing candidate Roberto Sánchez - a margin of less than 50,000 votes, figures certified by Peru's electoral court show.

It is the fourth time the daughter of disgraced former President Alberto Fujimori has sought the South American nation's presidency, promising this time to oversee a crackdown on organised crime.

Her election, coinciding with the election of Abelardo de la Espriella in Colombia, marks a shift towards the right in Latin American politics.

Fujimori said she would assume the role of president "with responsibility, humility and a deep sense of duty".

"Each day of this transition process is an opportunity to listen, engage in dialogue and arrive prepared at the start of the new government," she added, with what appeared to be a nod to her thin mandate.

Sánchez, 57, has alleged the runoff election had been "seriously compromised" and threatened legal action, arguing that strong support for Fujimori among Peruvian voters abroad was a sign of irregularities.

After the result was declared on Friday, his party appealed against the electoral court's proclamation, calling for the vote to be nullified.

While Sánchez, a former foreign trade minister, stood on a platform of broad economic reforms, Fujimori benefited from concerns over crime and political instability dominating the race.

Throughout the campaign, she leant on the controversial legacy of her father, promising a military crackdown on organised crime, in particular extortion incidents that have soared in recent years.

Alberto Fujimori was eventually jailed for crimes against humanity over extra-judicial killings and forced sterilisations undertaken during his increasingly authoritarian leadership.

Keiko also pledged to attract private investment to promote economic growth and to immediately expel any undocumented immigrants found to be committing crimes in Peru.

She stood unsuccessfully in 2011, 2016 and 2021, losing by similarly tight margins, during a period of intense political instability in Peru. She will become the Andean country's ninth president in a decade.

Her swearing-in ceremony is expected to take place on 28 July.

When she assumes office, she will be the latest addition to a host of ideologically aligned, right-wing leaders i

In a razor-thin race marred by protests and accusations, Keiko Fujimori has been declared the winner of Peru's presidential election by the electoral office. She secured 50.135% of the vote, narrowly defeating her rival, Roberto Sanchez, amidst allegations of fraud and a highly contested ballot review.

payload.title: Keiko Fujimori julistettiin Perun presidentinvaalien voittajaksi
payload.summary: Keiko Fujimori voitti Perun tiukan presidentinvaalien toisen kierroksen alle 50 000 äänen marginaalilla. Vaalituloksen vahvistaminen kesti lähes kuukauden, ja vastapuoli on kiistänyt tuloksen näyttöön perustumattomilla vilppiväitteillä.
payload.content:
Keiko Fujimori on julistettu Perun presidentinvaalien voittajaksi lähes kuukausi äänestyksen jälkeen. Perun vaalituomioistuimen vahvistamien lukujen mukaan oikeistolainen Fujimori sai 7. kesäkuuta pidetyllä toisella kierroksella 50,135 prosenttia äänistä, kun vasemmistolainen Roberto Sánchez sai 49,865 prosenttia.

## Ero jäi alle 50 000 ääneen

Vaalitulos oli poikkeuksellisen tiukka: Fujimorin voittomarginaali jäi alle 50 000 äänen. Ääntenlaskentaa ja vaalien jälkeistä tarkastelua seurasivat protestit ja syytökset, ja Sánchez ei ole tunnustanut Fujimorin voittoa. Hän on vedonnut vaalivilppiin, mutta väitteille ei ole esitetty näyttöä.

Fujimori sanoi ottavansa presidentin tehtävän vastaan ”vastuulla, nöyryydellä ja syvällä velvollisuudentunnolla”. Hänen voittonsa on samalla käänne hänen omalla poliittisella urallaan: Fujimori oli pyrkinyt Perun presidentiksi jo vuosina 2011, 2016 ja 2021, mutta hävisi aiemmat vaalit niukasti. Vuoden 2021 niukka tappio mainitaan taustana sille, miksi tämänkertainen tulos korostaa Perun politiikan syvää kahtiajakoa.

## Kampanjassa korostuivat turvallisuus ja talous

Fujimori kampanjoi järjestäytyneen rikollisuuden vastaisilla toimilla ja lupasi koventaa otteita erityisesti kiristysrikoksia vastaan, joiden kerrotaan lisääntyneen viime vuosina. Hän lupasi myös houkutella yksityisiä investointeja talouskasvun vauhdittamiseksi sekä karkottaa välittömästi paperittomat siirtolaiset, joiden todetaan syyllistyneen rikoksiin Perussa.

Fujimorin tausta on Perussa vahvasti jakava. Hän on entisen presidentin Alberto Fujimorin tytär ja nojasi kampanjassa isänsä kiisteltyyn perintöön. Alberto Fujimori tuomittiin myöhemmin rikoksista ihmisyyttä vastaan, jotka liittyivät muun muassa laittomiin teloituksiin ja pakkosterilointeihin hänen yhä autoritaarisemmaksi muuttuneella valtakaudellaan.

## Virkaanastujaisia odotetaan heinäkuussa

Keiko Fujimorin virkavalan odotetaan tapahtuvan 28. heinäkuuta. Hänen noustessaan virkaan Perussa aloittaa jo maan yhdeksäs presidentti vuosikymmenen aikana, mikä kertoo maan pitkään jatkuneesta poliittisesta epävakaudesta. Fujimorin valinta osuu myös samaan aikaan, kun Kolumbiassa Abelardo de la Espriellan vaalivoitto on tulkittu osaksi oikeiston vahvistumista Latinalaisessa Amerikassa.
summary_bullets: Keiko Fujimori sai Perun presidentinvaalien toisella kierroksella 50,135 prosenttia äänistä.
Roberto Sánchez ei ole tunnustanut tulosta ja on esittänyt näyttöön perustumattomia vilppiväitteitä.
